subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Dissipate
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"dissipate"** means to cause something to spread out and disappear. It often refers to the process of disappearing or vanishing. (बिखर जाना) • **Example: **The fog will dissipate as the sun rises higher in the sky. • **"Spend"** refers to using up or paying out money, time, or resources. (खर्च करना) • **Example: **We need to spend our resources wisely to ensure long-term sustainability. • Hence, we can infer that **'spend'** is a synonym for **'dissipate'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Glorious **(शानदार): Having, worthy of, or bringing fame or admiration. • **Example:** The team had a glorious victory in the championship match. • **Malicious **(दुर्भावनापूर्ण): Intended to do harm. • **Example: **He was found guilty of spreading malicious rumors about his colleague. • **Haste **(जल्दी): Excessive speed or urgency of movement or action. • **Example:** In his haste to leave, he forgot to lock the door. 11d:Tc57,
